# Vendored: canivc.com community score snapshot

- **Retrieved:** 2026-07-10
- **Source:** each suite's own published `index.json` report, fetched
  directly (not scraped from canivc.com's rendered HTML):
  - `https://w3c.github.io/vc-data-model-2.0-test-suite/index.json`
  - `https://w3c.github.io/vc-di-ecdsa-test-suite/index.json`
  - `https://w3c.github.io/vc-di-ed25519signature2020-test-suite/index.json`
  - `https://w3c.github.io/vc-di-eddsa-test-suite/index.json`
  - `https://w3c.github.io/vc-di-bbs-test-suite/index.json`
  - `https://w3c-ccg.github.io/did-key-test-suite/index.json`
  - `https://w3c-ccg.github.io/vc-api-issuer-test-suite/index.json`
  - `https://w3c-ccg.github.io/vc-api-verifier-test-suite/index.json`
  - `https://w3c.github.io/vc-bitstring-status-list-test-suite/index.json`
  - `https://w3c.github.io/vc-jose-cose-test-suite/index.json`

  These are the exact URLs canivc.com's own aggregator
  (`digitalbazaar/canivc`, `src/_data/results.js`) fetches — confirmed
  by reading that file directly, not guessed from the report titles.

- **canivc.com itself:** static 11ty site, `digitalbazaar/canivc` on
  GitHub. Its own licence (per that repo) applies to the SITE code;
  this snapshot does not vendor any of the site's code, only the
  underlying W3C/CCG test-suite JSON reports it aggregates.

- **Each report's own licence:** generated by
  `@digitalbazaar/mocha-w3c-interop-reporter` from each W3C Working
  Group / CCG Community Group test suite's own mocha run — published
  under the same licence as that suite's repository (typically
  `LicenseRef-w3c-3-clause-bsd-license-2008 OR
  LicenseRef-w3c-test-suite-license-2023`, or plain BSD-3-Clause for
  CCG suites — see each suite's own `LICENSE.md` if redistributing
  test content itself; this snapshot only extracts aggregate pass/fail
  counts, not test content).

## What's in `canivc-snapshot-2026-07-10.json`

Built by `formal/fstar` task #88 tooling (a one-off Python script, not
committed — the fetch + aggregation logic is straightforward: for each
suite's `index.json`, walk `matrices[].suites[]`, recursively sum
`tests[].state` (`passed`/`failed`/pending-or-other) per implementation
across ALL of that suite's matrices, excluding empty "at risk"/"interop"
placeholder matrices). Per suite: `aggregate` (n_implementations,
min/median/max pass percentage, top-3 implementations by name) and the
full per-implementation `implementations` list (pass/fail/pending/total/pct).
The `vc-di-eddsa` entry additionally carries `breakdowns` for the
`eddsa-rdfc-2022-issuers` / `eddsa-rdfc-2022-verifiers` matrices alone
(the exact 16+15=31 test scope this task's own
`tests/vc-di-eddsa/run.sh` measures, for a like-for-like comparison —
see `docs/designissues/2026-07-10-canivc-community-compat.md`).

This is a **point-in-time snapshot**, not a live feed — community
scores move as vendors fix bugs or their endpoints go up/down. Re-run
the fetch + aggregation (or re-crawl canivc.com) and vendor a new dated
file rather than editing this one, if a future task needs fresher
numbers.
